messages:
Maya: Quick async OKR pulse — please drop a one-line status for your milestone: shipped / slipped / at-risk, owner, cross-team deps, and next steps. I’ll compile for Friday AM. Example: 'Telemetry v2 — shipped — owner @Liam — dep: infra rollout — next: docs'. Thanks! :rocket:

Liam: Telemetry v2 — shipped yesterday. Owner: @Liam. No runtime blockers. PR merged (link: https://git.internal/r/redwood/telemetry/pull/812). Can follow up w/ short postmortem for perf delta. :tada:

Priya: API quota gating — slipped (was blocked by billing schema changes). Owner: @Priya. Dep: @Ava needs DB migration window. Next: finalize migration plan by Thu EOD. Tagging @eng-infra for window.

Ava: Re: migration window — can do Wed 02:00-03:00 UTC or Sat 04:00-06:00 UTC. Prefer Wed if downtime is small. Need confirmation on rollout script.

Jon: KV cache refactor — at-risk. Owner: @Jon. Unit tests flavoured red on CI; root cause looks like race when shard count changes. Dep: @eng-runtime for patch to scheduler. Next: I'm pairing w/ @Liam tomorrow AM to write a targeted integration test.

Sam: Load tests for Dedicated autoscaling — shipped to staging. Owner: @Sam. Found one SLO break at 95th p99 under burst; investigating. Filing a small rollback policy change if perf not improved by Friday.

Kira: Docs sprint — shipped two guides (pagination, streaming). Owner: @Kira. Remaining: private deployment guide draft by Wednesday. Happy to review screenshots if anyone has infra screenshots ready.

Priya: Follow-up — can folks add a one-line dependency tag with team handle (e.g., @eng-runtime, @eng-sre) so I can build dependency map? I'll mark everything in the spreadsheet.

Liam: Added @eng-runtime for KV cache refactor. Also flagging @eng-sre for autoscale load test follow-up.

Jon: Quick note — here's the failing test output for the race: ```
FAIL tests/test_kv_shard.py::test_shard_rebalance
AssertionError: expected 0 retries but got 2
```

Sam: Got it — @eng-runtime can you add more logging around rebalance fidelity? I'll re-run stage with the new build.

deploy-bot: deploy started by @Ava for telemetry-migration v1.2 — staging -> canary. Build: 2026.3.12-321.ETA ~ 15m. :information_source:

Ava: Noted. Will monitor canary and abort if error rate > 1%.

Priya: One more ask — if something is slipping, please add 'owner escalation' if you need help (e.g., "owner escalation: request infra slot"). It helps with priority at the weekly ops cadence.

Maya: Thanks all — I'll synthesize these into the shared tracker and ping owners for any clarifications. If anything ships before noon Friday, reply here so I can mark as shipped. :memo:
